segmentationGuide.role: magenta-key geometry guide; final water additionally requires master teal/shadow chroma

normalization.method: crop one bottom source row to 1672x940 exact 16:9, then direct nearest-neighbor resample; no squashing, no upscaling from old baseline

palette.quantizer: deterministic weighted median-cut with nearest-color assignment
palette.appliedTo: environment RGB; original.png retains source color appearance after nearest resampling

alpha.environment: 0 exactly on mask water pixels; 255 on land

water.segmentation: terrain magenta key AND master teal/shadow chroma (G>R+11, B>R+12, abs(G-B)<43, G<175)

motion.coordinateSpace: nearest-resampled source-master pixel coordinates, scaled directly to this grid
motion.maskSemantics: opaque grayscale; white=eligible source pixels, black=other; moving strands are narrowly selected from the source plate with fixed upper attachments; heavy roots are separately asserted anchored
motion.canopy: eligible foliage pixels selected in four semantic zones: banyan outer crown, overhead connected crown, middle-distance trees, and exposed far-right crown; independent owner silhouettes reject roof/house, banyan structural bough/trunk, planter/shore, and other fixed lotus destinations; overlapping flattened foliage remains fixed

ownership.encoding: opaque grayscale owner IDs: 0 free, 1 roof/house, 2 banyan structural trunk/bough, 3 planter/shore, 4 other fixed lotus clusters
ownership.authoring: independent hand-bounded 640x360 source-coordinate polygons uniformly projected to both native grids; not derived from movement eligibility
ownership.sourceAndDestination: both moving source and posed destination must have owner ID 0; destination writes into protected IDs are rejected

motion.canopyUnderplate: canopy-underplate.png is a native-grid, transparent-outside/opaque-inside 4-pixel-ring reconstruction derived only from adjacent nonmoving, owner-free canonical samples; used only behind accepted canopy cutouts
motion.strandUnderplate: aerial-strands-underplate.png has the same native-grid binary-alpha provenance for the four accepted hanging-strand cutouts; all moving candidates, water, and protected owners are excluded from its local source rings
motion.windResponse: tree foliage uses a 0.68 rad/s travelling regional phase and up to 3.74 native pixels at wind 1.5 (2.05px peak at default wind 0.6); lotus uses a 0.86 rad/s articulation cycle with 5.50px flower, 5.06px stem and 4.84px leaf peak at wind 1.5 (3.10/2.85/2.72px at default 0.6). Integer raster, shared regional field with small phase lags, wind clamped 0..1.5; zero wind exactly stationary.
motion.roots: heavy trunk and buttress roots remain stationary; roots-motion-mask.png is empty by design
motion.aerialRootStrands: four narrow, individually bounded dark hanging strands selected from canonical plate; upper attachment rows are pinned during wind deformation
motion.lotus: pink flower and bud components of one clear left lotus rig; attached to individually selected stem components with small constrained distal lag.
motion.lotusStems: two narrow geometry-and-color selected stem strips for the clear main flower and bud, pinned at lower visible shoreline/leaf attachment rows (native source y≈292 and y≈291); motion never reaches shore pixels.
motion.lotusLeaves: three bounded green leaf/pad components in the same clear left lotus group; coherent low-amplitude sway with shared wind and slight phase lag. Occluded/right-bank plants excluded.
